en: A multi-view color postcard featuring exterior and interior views of a historic mosque with a tall stone minaret and domed roof, along with surrounding city walls and buildings. The front has three photos and a beige background with the word "PÉCS" printed below the images. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard layout with space for address and message, red stamp boxes, and printed captions in multiple languages describing Jakovali Hassan's Mosque and its minaret.
